ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels accounting for approximately 92% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters isolated to the distal tips and stochastic speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark-intensity base across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast contiguous clusters (white) mapped to the distal left and right vertices. Sparse, non-contiguous high-intensity pixel noise (speckling) concentrated in the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped indentation with a vertex angle of approximately 18 degrees and a vertical depth occupying 12% of the central lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 3-8 pixels; more pronounced and jagged on the left lobe trailing edge compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, terminating in acute distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two high-density clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel nodes (barnacle colonies) located at the far distal tips of both lobes; 5 distinct nodes on the right tip, 4-6 obscured nodes on the left tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified barnacle colonization at the extreme distal margins of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized high-density white speckling across the lower portion of the right lobe, forming a non-geometric salt-and-pepper pattern.
